name: Hiraizumi Chitose
source:
A second-year student at the academy. She's [url=/c91518]Dankonmaru[/url]'s childhood friend and classmate.

They used to play together often as children, but as they grew older,
she started criticizing the protagonist's shortcomings.

She's a kind and considerate friend, but she's shy and often says mean things to hide her embarrassment, which leads to misunderstandings.

She's also critical of Dankonmaru, constantly nagging him about his appearance and telling him to study.

[From [url=http://gyutto.com/i/item152444?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
